m: शिरस् n. (prob. originally शरस् = करस्; and connected with करङ्क, q.v.) the head, skull (acc. with √ दा, ‘to give up one's head i.e. life’; with √ धृ, or √ वह्, ‘to hold up one's head, be proud’; with Caus. of √ वृत् or with उप-√ स्था, ‘to hold out the head’, ‘acknowledge one's self guilty’, see शिरोपस्थायिन्; instr. with √ ग्रह्, √ धा, √ धृ, वि-√ धृ, √ भृ, √ वह्, or √ कृ, ‘to hold or carry or place on the head, receive deferentially’; instr. with √ गम्, अभि-√ गम्, प्र-√ ग्रह्, √ या, प्र-णम् [√ नम्], नि-√ पत्, प्र-णि-√ पत्, ‘to touch with the head, bow or fall down before’; loc. with √ कृ or नि-√ धा, ‘to place on one's head’; loc. with √ स्था, ‘to be on or stand over a person's head, stand far above [gen.]’), RV. &c. &c.
the upper end or highest part of anything, top, peak, summit, pinnacle, acme, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
the forepart or van (of an army), Śiś.
the beginning (of a verse), VarBṛS.
(ifc.) the head, leader, chief, foremost, first (of a class), BhP.
N. of the verse आपो ज्योतिर् आपो ऽमृतम्, Baudh.; Viṣṇ. &c.
of a Sāman (also with इन्द्रस्य), ĀrṣBr.; Lāṭy.
of a mountain, Buddh.
शिरस् [cf. शीर्षन्; Gk. κέρας, κάρη &c.; Lat. cerebrum for ceresrum, cornu; Germ. hirni, Hirn; Eng. horn.]
a: शिरस् — n. [शॄ-असुन् निपातः Uṇ. 4. 193] 1 The head; शिरसा श्लाघते पूर्वं (गुणं) परं (दोषं) कंठे नियच्छति Subhāṣ. --2 Skull. --3 A peak, summit, top (as of a mountain); हिमगौरैरचलाधिपः शिरोभिः Ki. 5. 17; Śi. 4. 54. --4 The top of a tree. --5 The head or top of anything; शिरसि मपीपटलं दधाति दीपः Bv. 1. 74. --6 Pinnacle, acme, highest point. --7 Front, forepart, van (as of an army); पुत्रस्य ते रणशिरस्ययमग्रयायी Ś. 7. 26; U. 5. 3. --8 Chief, principal, head (usually at the end of comp.). --Comp. --अस्थि n. (शिरोस्थि) the skull. --कपालिन् m. an ascetic who carries about a human skull. --गृहं ( शिरोगृहं) a room on the top of a house, turret, garret. --ग्रहः (शिरोग्रहः) affection of the head, head-ache. --छदः, --छेदनं (शिरश्छेदः &c.) beheading, decapitation. --तापिन् m. an elephant. --त्रं, --त्राणं {1} a helmet; च्युतैः शिरस्त्रैश्चषकोत्तरेव R. 7. 49, 66; अपनीतशिरस्त्राणाः 4. 64. {2} a headdress. --धरा, --धिः (शिरोधरा --धि) the neck; Śi. 4. 52, 5. 65. --पीडा headache. --प्रणामः bending the head. --प्रावरणं a turban. --फठः the cocoanut tree. --भूषणं (शिरोभूषणं) an ornament for the head. --मणिः (शिरोमणिः) {1} a jewel worn on the head. {2} a crest-jewel. {3} a title of respect conferred on learned men. --मर्मन् m. (शिरोमर्मन्) a hog. --मालिन् m. (शिरोमालिन्) an epithet of Śiva. --रत्नं (शिरोरत्नं) a jewel worn on the head. --रुजा (शिरोरुजा) head-ache. --रुह् m. --रुहः ( शिरोरुह्रुहः) (also शिरसिरुह्-हः) the hair of the head; Rs. 1. 4, Ku. 5. 9; R. 15. 16. --वर्तिन् a. (शिरोवर्तिन्) being at the head. (--m.) a chief, any one at the head of affairs. --वल्ली ( शिरोवल्ली) the crest of a peacock. --वृत्तं (शिरोवृत्तं) pepper. --वेष्टः, वेष्टनं ( शिरोवेष्ट्रः-ष्टनं) a head-dress, turban. --शूलं head-ache. --स्थः leader, chief. --हारिन् m. (शिरोहारिन्) an epithet of Śiva.

k.v: शिरोग्रं शिखरं वा ना मूलं बुध्नोऽङ्घ्रिनामकः। सारो मज्जा नरि त्वक्स्त्री वल्कं वल्कलमस्त्रियाम्.।
उत्तमाङ्गं शिरः शीर्षं मूर्धा ना मस्तकोऽस्त्रियाम्. चिकुरः कुन्तलो वालः कचः केशः शिरोरुहः॥
गण्डः कटो मदो दानं वमथुः करशीकरः। कुम्भौ तु पिण्डौ शिरसस्तयोर्मध्ये विदुः पुमान्.।

s: puM, (Siraso romaH .) mastakapIqA । yaTA, -- aTa SirorogADikAraH । atra Sirorogasya nidAnaM saKyAYcAha । “SirorogAstu jAyante vAtapittakaPEstriBiH । sannipAtena raktena kzayeRa kfmiBistaTA ॥ sUryyAvarttAnantavAtaSaMKakArdDAvaBedakAH । ekAdaSaviDasyAsya lakzaRAni pracakzate ॥” SirorogA atra SirorogaH SUlarUpA rugaBiDIyate । vAtapittakaPEstriBiH । nanu vAtapittakaPErityukte tattritvaboDAt । kimarTaM triBiriti padam । vAtapittakaPAnAM pfTakkAraRatvaboDanArTam । tarhi sarva eva SirorogAH sannipAtasamudBavA iti kaTam । tadA vAtAdaya ulvaRatayA pfTakkAraRAni bodDavyAni । kzayeRa rasAdikzayeRa ॥ * ॥ vAtikasya lakzaRamAha । “yasyAnimittaM Siraso rujaSca Bavanti tIvrA niSi cAtimAtram banDopatApEH praSamaSca yatra Siro'BitApaH sa samIraRena ॥” Bavediti viSezaH । animittaM atarkitaviprakfzwanimittam । niSi cAtimAtraM rAtrI SEtyena rogADikyAt । pratApaH svedanam । Siro'BitApaH SiraHpIqA ॥ * ॥ pEttikamAha । “yasyozRamaNgAracitaM yaTEva BavecCiro dahyati nAkzinASam । SItena rAtrO ca BavecCamaSca Siro'BitApaH sa tu pittakopAt ॥ dahyatItyArzatvAt ॥ * ॥ SlEzmikamAha । “Siro Bavedyasya kaPopadigDaM guru pratizwabDamaTo himaYca । sUnAkzinAsAvadanaYca yasya Siro'BitApaH sa kaPaprakopAt ॥” kaPopadigDaM antaHkaPaliptam । pratizwabDaM stabDaSiram ॥ * ॥ sAnnipAtikamAha । “Siro'BitApe tritayapravftte sarvARi liNgAni samudBavanti ॥” * ॥ raktajamAha । “raktAtmikaH pittasamAnaliNgasparSAsahatvaM Siraso Bavecca ॥” pEttikAdBedakaliNgamAha । SiraHsparSAsahatvamiti ॥ * ॥ kzayajamAha । “vasAvalAsakzatasamBavAnAM SirogatAnAmatisaMkzayeRa । kzayapravfttiH Siraso'BitApaH kazwo Bavedugrarujo'timAtram ॥” kzatasamBavaM ruDiram । kazwaH kfcCrasADyaH । “Sramo Bramati tudyeta Siro viBrAntanetratA । mUrcCA gAtrAvasAdaSca Siroroge kzayAtmike ॥” kfmijamAha । “nistudyate yasya Siro'timAtraM saMBakzyamARaM sPuratIva cAntaH । GrARAcca gacCedruDiraM sapUyaM Siro'BitApaH kfmiBiH saGoraH ॥” saMBakzyamARaM kfmiBiriti SezaH । GnARAcceti cakAreRa kfminirgamo'pi boDyate ॥ * ॥ sUryyAvarttamAha । “sUryyodayaM yA pratimandamandamakziBruvaM ruk samupEti gAQam । vivardDate cAMSumatA sahEva sUryyAvavfttO vinivarttate ca ॥ SItena SAntiM laBate ca kiYciduzRena jantuH suKamApnuyAdvA । sarvvAtmakaM kazwatamaM vikAraM sUryyAvavarttaM tamudAharanti ॥” sUryyodayamiti lakzIkftya AraByeti yAvat । sUryyasyAvavfttI sUryyasyADogatO ॥ * ॥ anantavAtamAha । “dozAstu duzwAH svayameva manyAM saMpIqya GAwAM svarujAM sutIvrAm । kurvanti so'kzRi Bruvi SaNKadeSe sTitiM karotyASu viSezatastu ॥ gaRqasya pArSve tu karoti kampaM hanugrahaM locanajAn vikArAn । anantavAtaM tamudAharanti dozatrayotTaM Siraso vikAram ॥” evaSabdo'trApyarTaH । avyayAnAmanekArTatvAt । svarujAM svasya rujAM vyaTAdAhagOravAdirUpAM dozAH kurvanti । ayamanantavAtaH । sa anantavAtaH akzyAdizu sTitiM karoti । viSezataH gaRqapArSve sTitiM karoti । pIqayA sTitiM kftvA kampAdIMSca karoti ॥ * ॥ SaNKakamAha । “pittaraktAnilA duzwAH SaNKadeSe vimUrcCitAH ॥ tIvrarugdAharAgaM hi SoTaM kurvanti dAruRam ॥ sa SirovizavadvegAn niruDyASu galaM taTA । trirAtrAjjIvitaM hanti SaNKako nAma nAmataH । tryahAjjIvati BEzajyaM pratyAKyeyasya kArayet ॥” pittaraktAnilAH atra kaPo'pi yojyaH । kftAnutApaH kaPapittaraktEriti suSrutavacanAt । vimUrcCitAH pravfdDAH । sa SoTaH । trirAtrAt trirAtramaDye mArayati ॥ * ॥ ardDAvaBedakamAha । “rUkzASanAdyaDyaSanAvaSyAprAgvAtamETunEH । vegasaMDAraRAyAsavyAyAmEH kupito'nilaH ॥ kevalaH sakaPo vArdDaM gfhItvA Siraso balI । manyABrUSaNKakarRAkzilalAwArdDezu vedanAm ॥ SastrASaniniBAM kuryyAttIvrAM so'rdDAvaBedakaH । nayanaM vATavA SrotramaBivfdDO vinASayet ॥” avaSyA avaSyAyaH । AyAsaH atibalena BArodvahanAdiBiH । vyAyAmaH svalpaSramaH । SastrASaniniBAM SastrapAtenEva vajrapAtenEva vedanAm ॥ * ॥ aTa SirorogARAM cikitsyA । “vAtajAte Siroroge snehasvedaM vivarddanam । pAnAhAropanAhAMSca kuryyAdvAtAmayApahAM ॥ kuzWameraRqamUle ca nAgare tatra pezitam । kawUzRaM SirasaH pIqAM BAle lepanato haret ॥ rasaH SvAsakuWArotTastasya nasyaM viSezataH । SiraHSUlaM haratyeva viDeyo nAtra saMSayaH ॥” * ॥ aTa SirovastiviDiH । “ASirovyApi taccarmma zoqazANgulamucCritam । tenAvezwya Siro'DastAnmAzakalkena lepayet ॥ niScalasyopavizwasya tElEH kozREH prapUrayet । DArayedArujaH SAntyE yAmaM yAmArdDameva ca ॥ Sirovastirharatyeza SirorogaM marudBavam । hanumanyAkzikarRArttimardditaM mUrdDakampanam । vinA BojanamevEza SirovastyAH prayujyate ॥ dinAni paYca vA sapta ruji tatparato'pi vA । tato'panItasnehastu mocayedvastibanDanam ॥ SirolalAwavadanagrIvAdIni vimarddayet । suKozRenAmBasA gAtraM prakzAlyASnAti yadDitama ॥ AmizaM jANgalaM paTyaM tatra SAlyAdayo'pi ca । mudgAn mAzAn kulatTAMSca KAdedvA niSi kevalAn ॥ kawukozRAnsasarpizkAnuzRaM kzIraM pibettaTA । pittAtmake Siroroge SItAnAM candanAmBasAm ॥ kumudotpalapadmAnAM sparSAH sevyASca mArutAH । sarpizaH SataDOtasya SirasA DAraRaM hitam ॥ rasaH SvAsakuWArotTaH karpUraM kuNkumaM navam । SItaM CAgIpayaH sarvaM vadanenAnuvarzayet ॥ tasya nasyaM BizagdadyAt pittalAyAM Siroruji । kintu mastakaSUlezu sarvezvevaM hitaM matam ॥ guqanAgarakalkasya nasyaM mastakaSUlanut ॥ * ॥ raktaje pittavat sarvaM BojanAlepasevanam ॥ SItozRayoSca vinyAso viSezo raktamokzaRam । kaPaje laNGanaM svedo rUkzozREH pAvakAtmakEH ॥ * ॥ sannipAtaBave kAryyA sannipAtaharI kriyA । purARasarpisaH pAnaM viSezeRa diSanti hi ॥ eraRqamUlaM tagaraM SatAhvA jIvantikA sEnDavarAsnike ca । BfNgaM viqaNgaM maDuyazwikA ca viSvOzaDaM kfzRatilasya tElam ॥ ajApayastElavimiSritaYca caturguRaM BfNgarase vipakvam । zaqbindavo nAsikayoH pradeyAH sarvvARi hanyuH Siraso vikArAn ॥ cyutAMSca keSAn palitAMSca dantAn nirbaDya mUlAn prakawIkaroti । suparRagfDrapratimaYca cakzuH kurvanti bAhvoraDikaM balaYca ॥” jIvantikA atra harItakI SAkaviSezaSca । iti zaqbindutElam ॥ * ॥ “kzayaje kzayanASAya karttavyo bfMhaRo viDiH । pAne nasye ca sarpiH syAdvAtaGnErmaDurEH Sftam ॥ * ॥ kfmije vyozaRaYcAhuH SigrubIjESca lAvaRam । ajAmUtrayutaM nasyaM karttavyaM kfminut param ॥ sUryyAvartte viDAtavyaM nasyakarmmAdiBezajam । yojayet saguqaM sarpirGftapUpAMSca Bakzayet ॥ lAvanaM kzIrasarpirByAM pAnaYca kzIrasarpizoH । kzIrapizwastilEH svedI jIvanIyESca Sasyate ॥ BfNgarAjarasacCAgakzIratulyArkatApitaH । sUryyAvarttaM nihantyASu nasyenEva prayogarAw ॥ * ॥ ardDAvaBedake pUrvvaM snehasvedo hi Bezajam ॥ virekaH kAyaSudDiSca DUpasnigDozRaBojaRam । viqaNgAni tilAn kfzRAn samAn pizwvA vilepayet ॥ nasyaM vApyAcarettasmAdardDaBedaM vyapohati । pibet saSakaraM kzIraM nIraM vA nArikelajam ॥ suSItaM vApi pAnIyaM sarpirvvA nastatastayoH ॥” nastataH nAsikayA pibedityanvayaH । tayoH sUryyAvarttArdDaBedayoH ॥ * ॥ “anantavAte karttavyaH sUryyAvarttahito viDiH । SirAvyaDaSca karttavyo'nantavAtapraSAntaye ॥ AhAraSca pradAtavyo vAtapittavinASanaH । maDumastakasaMyAvaGftapUpErviSezataH ॥” saMyAvaH pakvAnnaviSezaH । erakiyA iti loke । sa ca maDumastakaH maGunopaliptaH । GftapUro'pUpaH । “paTyAkzaDAtrI rajanI guqUcI BUnimbanimbEH saguqaH kazAyaH । BrUSaNKakarRAkziSiro'rdDaSUlaM nihanti nAsAnihitaH kzaRena ॥” iti paTyAdikvATaH ॥ * ॥ “dArvvI haridrA maYjizWA sanimboSIrapadmakam । etatpralepanaM kuryyAcCaNKakasya vinASayet ॥ pItatoyABizekaYca SItalakzIrasevanam । kalkESca kzIravfkzARAM SaNKake lepanaM hitam ॥” sarvazu ।
